subject: Peregrine Therapeutics - HQ demo: logistics, badging & transport
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.j@peregrine.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed HQ demo dates + logistics (Peregrine POC)

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. We are excited to host the Peregrine team for a short POC at our Novato HQ. To keep logistics simple, would any of these windows work for you and Marcus:

- Tue Nov 24 (morning, 9:30–12:30) — light traffic expected, shorter lunch window
- Fri Nov 27 (afternoon, 12:30–16:00) — quieter campus, preferred if your team needs a full run-of-show
- Mon Nov 30 (all day) — flexible but higher building occupancy

A few items we need to confirm from your side:
1) Full names & emails for badging + any government ID requirements
2) Do you need a shuttle from SFO/OAK, or will you arrange travel independently? We can arrange a company shuttle from SFO with a drop at the main lobby.
3) Any dietary restrictions for the lunch we’ll provide?
4) Security contact for SOC2 evidence requests (if applicable)

Attaching the current mutual action plan for the POC (Peregrine_Mutual-Action-Plan_v3.pdf). If Friday 11/27 is best we’ll reserve the demo room and send a draft run-of-show.

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Peregrine_Mutual-Action-Plan_v3.pdf
From: Laura Jensen <laura.j@peregrine.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Doyle <mdoyle@peregrine.com>, Peregrine Security <security@peregrine.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed HQ demo dates + logistics (Peregrine POC)

Rafael —

Appreciate the options. Marcus and I talked; the team prefers the week after Thanksgiving and Friday 11/27 afternoon is our preference. Marcus will fly in that morning.

A few notes from Security (cc’d): they will need a short SOC2 summary and an inventory of devices that will be on the demo lane. Security will review the mutual action plan and respond with any evidence requests by next Tuesday.

For badging: I’ll send a spreadsheet with names and DOBs — is the company able to accept driver’s license scans in advance?

We’ll also request a parking pass for Marcus; otherwise we’ll use the shuttle.

Laura Jensen
Head of Product Ops, Peregrine Therapeutics
laura.j@peregrine.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.j@peregrine.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Peregrine Security <security@peregrine.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed HQ demo dates + logistics (Peregrine POC)

Laura / Marcus / Security team —

Great — holding Friday 2026-11-27 12:30–16:00 for the POC (demo room C). Marissa will own on-site ops (escort, AV check, catering).

Logistics we’ve arranged on our side: 
- Meeting room: Demo Room C (ground floor, capacity 12) — AV: HDMI + Thunderbolt, projector, mic
- Shuttle: SFO -> Novato, pick-up 11/27 10:00 AM (pickup point: Terminal 3, curbside). Marcus, let us know if you prefer an earlier pickup.
- Parking: one reserved visitor spot (level B) for Marcus — pls confirm license plate in the badging list
- Food: plated lunch and two snack breaks; pls advise dietary needs
- Security: we can accept driver’s license scans over secure upload. If you prefer, you can drop the scans in the link below and we will preload badges.

Attached: visitor_badging_list.csv (please fill with full names, DOB, license number/license state, license image filename). Also adding a small run-of-show stub (run_of_show_link.txt) with the agenda.

Next steps: 
- Laura: send the completed badging list and indicate who will take the shuttle
- Security: confirm any additional evidence requests by Tue 11/24 EOD so Marissa can prepare
- Marissa: I’ll ask you to confirm escort assignment and AV lead today.

Thanks — looking forward to hosting you.

Rafael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: visitor_badging_list.csv
Attachment: run_of_show_link.txt
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Peregrine Therapeutics - HQ demo: logistics, badging & transport

Hi all —

Quick operational confirmation for tomorrow’s 12:30 start: 
- Escort: Marissa Cole will meet the group in the main lobby at 12:10 PM (look for Redwood badge desk).
- Badging: Badges preloaded for Marcus Doyle (license: CA 7D4M213) and the attendees listed in the file we received.
- Parking: Reserved spot B3 held for Marcus — license plate added to guest list.
- AV/Connectivity: AV lead (Daniel Kim) will confirm mic & projector at 11:45 AM and remain for the first 10 minutes of the POC.
- Shuttle drop: SFO drop-off scheduled 11:55 AM at the main lobby; driver (Carlos) will text when en route.

Run-of-show is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz/poc-runbook (view only). Please review the timeline — we have a 15-minute Q&A at the end.

If anything changes on your ETA please text Marissa (415-555-0179) so we can adjust escort timing. Looking forward to a smooth session.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
